'''Jak Bremen's daughter''' was the daughter of [[Jak Bremen]] and the daughter of [[Jak Bremen's wife]]. She was killed when her father was on a hunting trip. Jak tracked the killers to a hidden Imperial garrison established by [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order|COMPNOR]] in order to complete a mission.<ref name="TLCSB">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref>
